text:
Maya: quick follow-up on the continuous-batching RFC — thinking about adding a 'rendezvous window' between admission and commit so small requests don't wait forever behind big ones. Proposal: soft-deadline per request, early-commit path for low-token ones, and a 'retry-as-mini' fallback. sketch below. thoughts?

Oliver: can you list the invariants this must preserve? worried about headroom and tenant starvation.

Maya: invariants:
- p99 latency <= SLO baseline
- no tenant starvation > 500ms
- batch utilization >= 60%

Draft config:
```
{
  "rendezvous_ms": 8,
  "soft_deadline_ms": 50,
  "mini_threshold_tokens": 16,
  "max_wait_ms": 150,
  "fallback_policy": "retry-mini"
}
```

Rachel: big concern: splitting into minis can thrash the KV cache and increase subsequent long-context costs. We should only fallback to mini for single-turn or short-chat requests. Otherwise we might regress cost.

Sumeet: agree. metrics to track: mini_fallback_rate, p50/p95/p99 delta, kv_cache_miss_delta, avg_batch_fill, tail_retries. suggest running trace replays (last 7 days) with simulator.

Oliver: also need per-tenant flags and an operator rollout plan (canary + alarm). We'll need automatic revert if p99 increases.

Maya: will add per-tenant override and rollout steps. I'll run the sim and open a PR with telemetry hooks + operator flags.

deploy-bot: commit 7a1c9f3 pushed to feature/rendezvous-window: feature flag + basic impl.

Maya: :thumbsup: thanks — will follow up with PR link and sim results. if anyone wants to join the sim run, ping me.
